Title: Azure Backup Available In Japan East and Japan West

Body.Content: Azure Backup is now available in Japan East and Japan West with the same service-level agreement coverage available in other regions worldwide. Azure Backup can help you back up and recover data across Windows Server and Microsoft System Center. You can store and recover files, SQL Server database snapshots, and Hyper-V virtual machines in the cloud. For more information about services' regional availability, visit our Azure Regions page.
